title: Defense Department Releases Seventh PURSUE Tranche of 10 UAP Files, Including Silent Black Triangle Report
detail: On Oct 23, 2026 the Defense Department released its seventh batch of declassified UAP records through the PURSUE portal, adding 10 files. Contents include FBI and DoD reports of federal agents who saw a silent, matte-black triangular object rise above a ridgeline near a secure US facility, hover, and move about 1.5 miles in three seconds (date and location redacted), 1940s records, a 2010 report on Utah's Skinwalker Ranch, historical sighting reports, and NASA/DoD procedures for handling suspected space-vehicle fragments. Officials say 'unresolved' means investigators lacked enough information for identification, not that the objects are linked to extraterrestrial activity. One report lists the cumulative archive at about 478 files as of Oct 27.
confidenceReason: Two independent outlets report the release; official PURSUE portal not directly read in this run.

media.caption: Federal agents reported a silent black triangle in the latest UFO file release
